monitor_scheduler: CLI/manual invocation by default; pg-boss is an optional dependency, manually configured and not wired into the main flow
durable_store: atomic local JSON with per-record CAS and append-only run events
langgraph_checkpointer: in-process MemorySaver for graph scheduling plus immutable content-addressed model-call checkpoints and durable host run ledger; restart creates a new revision and reuses only exact-hash validated seat outputs
snapshot_store: local content-addressed immutable evidence files verified by SHA-256
notification: built-in macOS provider/manual-assistance alerts; OpenClaw remains an optional frozen-summary gateway
design_rule: LangGraph owns execution topology; Rulora owns field gates and freezes; programs own evidence eligibility and final actions; models only propose candidates.
